note: Hand-entered listings. Merged on every run and always win a dedupe tie against a scraped listing, so this file is how you correct the robots. Anything in here must be verified against the venue first: a curated listing carries your word rather than a feed's.
shape: See docs/feed-contract.md. Required: id, title, kind, date, time, venue, venueId, region, url. The source field is overwritten with curated, so leave it out.
